Chapter 6 - Telephone Tools / Telephone Tools Reference

Constants

This section describes the constants provided by the Telephone Manager that you can use in a telephone tool. These constants define the resource types and messages for the tool's code resources. They also define the messages that your tool might need to send to the Telephone Manager's master message handlers.
